title: Isoginkgetin protects against degeneration of ALS motor neurons via regulating the GSK-3beta-TFEB signaling axis.
authors: Li, Ang; Xiao, Xianglu; Liu, Guopan; Li, Krinos; Ling, Yixia; Deng, Shenglong; Xu, Chunzuan; Cao, Shu-Qin; Wen, Jing; Lu, Guang; Yang, Guang; Fang, Evandro F; Qin, Dajiang; Su, Huanxing
one_liner_zh: 该文研究小分子化合物通过抑制GSK-3beta激活TFEB以保护ALS运动神经元，核心是药物靶点与信号通路，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或结合建模，与课题无关。
abstract: Lysosomal dysfunction is a core pathological driver of neurodegenerative diseases such as amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). Transcription factor EB (TFEB) serves as a master regulator of lysosomal biogenesis, and its pharmacological activation represents a strategy to restore lysosomal function in disease and aging. Here, using a series of artificial intelligence-powered computational virtual screening workflows, we have identified isoginkgetin (ISO), a small-molecule compound, as a potent TFEB activator that promotes mechanistic target of rapamycin complex 1 (mTORC1)-independent TFEB nuclear translocation to enhance lysosomal biogenesis and function. Mechanistically, ISO functions as an ATP-competitive inhibitor that binds to the key Lys85 residue within the ATP-binding pocket of glycogen synthase kinase 3beta (GSK-3beta), thereby regulating the GSK-3beta-TFEB signaling axis to activate TFEB nuclear translocation. Functionally, ISO improves lysosomal function and protects motor neurons differentiated from induced pluripotent stem cells derived from patients with ALS from degeneration. Collectively, these results support the hypothesis that lysosomal dysfunction is a druggable target for ALS.
abstract_zh: 溶酶体功能障碍是肌萎缩侧索硬化（amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, ALS）等神经退行性疾病的核心病理驱动因素。转录因子EB（TFEB）作为溶酶体生物发生的主要调控因子，其药理学激活代表了一种在疾病和衰老中恢复溶酶体功能的策略。在此，通过一系列人工智能驱动的计算虚拟筛选工作流程，我们鉴定出异银杏双黄酮（isoginkgetin, ISO），一种小分子化合物，作为强效TFEB激活剂，可促进不依赖雷帕霉素靶蛋白复合物1（mTORC1）的TFEB核转位，从而增强溶酶体生物发生和功能。机制上，ISO作为ATP竞争性抑制剂，与糖原合酶激酶3β（GSK-3β）ATP结合口袋内的关键Lys85残基结合，从而调控GSK-3β-TFEB信号轴以激活TFEB核转位。功能上，ISO改善溶酶体功能，并保护由ALS患者来源的诱导多能干细胞分化而来的运动神经元免受变性。总体而言，这些结果支持溶酶体功能障碍是ALS可药物干预靶点的假说。
